title: 第一卷 第10章 你现在这样有意思吗？
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

第五题，也是最后一题。

主持人看了一眼手卡，笑容重新变得神秘。

“最后一题，请写出你认为对方最可能喜欢什么样的人。”

宋尔尔握着笔，第一次停顿了。

她看了一眼陆执。

陆执也看着她。

两人短暂对视。

宋尔尔忽然觉得这个问题有点麻烦。

写得太认真，像她真在观察陆执。

写得太敷衍，又显得她上班不认真。

她想了想，低头写下答案。

陆执也写完了。

前两组答案都很安全。

林栀写顾南舟喜欢温柔懂事的人。

顾南舟写林栀喜欢成熟可靠的人。

周闻野写姜眠喜欢不会吓她的人。

姜眠写周闻野喜欢不麻烦的人。

轮到宋尔尔和陆执。

主持人明显期待：“来，我们看看两位的答案。”

宋尔尔翻板。

上面写着：不吵、懂事、能自己活。

主持人忍住笑：“尔尔觉得陆老师喜欢这种？”

宋尔尔：“我合理推测，陆老师看起来不像喜欢麻烦的人。”

陆执看着她的答案，没反驳。

主持人问：“那陆老师呢？”

陆执翻板。

上面写着：不装。

两个字。

很简单。

但很准。

宋尔尔看着那两个字，手指在答题板边缘轻轻敲了一下。

主持人追问：“陆老师觉得尔尔喜欢不装的人？”

陆执：“嗯。”

主持人：“为什么？”

陆执：“她不喜欢演。”

宋尔尔立刻开口：“陆老师，这话在娱乐圈说有点危险。”

陆执：“我说的是生活里。”

宋尔尔：“生活里也危险，很多人靠演生活续命。”

陆执看她：“你呢？”

宋尔尔顿了顿。

“我靠工资。”

弹幕停顿一秒，随后狂刷。

【哈哈哈哈刚有点暧昧，她又靠工资。】

【宋尔尔你别把心动掐死得这么快！】

【陆执真的每次都能看穿她一点。】

【不装，清醒，这两个词好绝。】

最终分数统计出来。

宋尔尔和陆执，两分。

第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The fifth question is also the last question.

The host glanced at the card and his smile became mysterious again.

"For the last question, please write down what kind of person you think the other person is most likely to like."

Song Er'er held the pen and paused for the first time.

She glanced at Lu Zhi.

Lu Zhi also looked at her.

The two looked at each other briefly.

Song Er'er suddenly felt that this problem was a bit troublesome.

The writing was so serious, it felt like she was really observing Lu Zhi.

The writing was too perfunctory, and it seemed that she was not serious about her work.

She thought for a while, lowered her head and wrote down the answer.

Lu Zhi also finished writing.

The first two sets of answers are safe.

Lin Zhi wrote that Gu Nanzhou likes gentle and sensible people.

Gu Nanzhou wrote that Lin Zhi likes mature and reliable people.

Zhou Wenye wrote that Jiang Mian likes people who don’t scare her.

Jiang Mian writes that Zhou Wenye likes people who are not troublesome.

It was Song Er'er and Lu Zhi's turn.

The host was obviously looking forward to it: "Come on, let's see your answers."

Songer turned over.

It says: Don't be noisy, be sensible, and be able to live on your own.

The host couldn't help laughing: "You think Teacher Lu likes this kind of thing?"

Song Er'er: "My reasonable guess is that Teacher Lu doesn't look like someone who likes trouble."

Lu Zhi looked at her answer and did not refute.

The host asked: "What about Teacher Lu?"

Lu Zhi flipped the board.

It says: Not pretending.

Two words.

Very simple.

But very accurate.

Song Er'er looked at those two words and tapped his finger on the edge of the answer board.

The host asked: "Teacher Lu, do you think Er Er likes people who don't pretend?"

Lu Zhi: "Yeah."

Host: "Why?"

Lu Zhi: "She doesn't like acting."

Song Er'er immediately spoke: "Teacher Lu, this is a bit dangerous to say in the entertainment industry."

Lu Zhi: "I'm talking about life."

Song Er'er: "Life is also dangerous, and many people rely on acting to survive."

Lu Zhi looked at her: "What about you?"

Song Er paused.

"I live on a salary."

The barrage paused for a second, and then started blasting.

[Hahahaha, it was a bit ambiguous just now, and she relies on salary.】

[Song Er'er, don't kill your heartbeat so quickly!】

[Lu Zhi really can see through her a little bit every time.】

[No pretense, sobriety, these two words are perfect.】

The final score is tallied up.

Song Er'er and Lu Zhi, two points.
